stories.title: Nueva especie de gato salvaje aparece en los bosques de Bolivia; familia local entregó al ejemplar para ser revisado

en.title: New wild cat species appears in Bolivia's forests; local family handed over specimen for examination
en.summary: A new wild cat species, named Leopardus tilcayo in honor of local communities, was discovered in Bolivian forests and brought to researchers for study.

stories.title: Hideo Kojima revela nuevos detalles sobre PHYSINT; el actor Bill Skarsgård protagonizará el videojuego

en.title: Hideo Kojima reveals new details about PHYSINT; actor Bill Skarsgård will star in the video game
en.summary: Director Hideo Kojima announced that actor Bill Skarsgård will appear in the upcoming video game PHYSINT as part of a strategic partnership between Kojima Productions and Xbox Games Studios.

stories.title: Volvo XC60 y XC90 PHEV con más autonomía eléctrica

en.title: Volvo XC60 and XC90 PHEV with increased electric range
en.summary: Volvo introduced updated versions of the XC60 and XC90 plug-in hybrid vehicles featuring improved electric driving range.

stories.title: Aguascalientes tendrá 100 kilómetros de fibra óptica subterránea para ampliar conectividad con Estados Unidos

en.title: Aguascalientes will have 100 kilometers of underground fiber optic cable to expand connectivity with the United States
en.summary: Aguascalientes is implementing 100 kilometers of underground fiber optic infrastructure to enhance digital connectivity with the United States.

stories.title: Localizan sin vida a Karla Margarita Pérez Jiménez, estudiante de Medicina desaparecida en Zapopan

en.title: Body of Karla Margarita Pérez Jiménez, missing medical student in Zapopan, found
en.summary: Authorities in Jalisco are investigating the death of a 22-year-old medical student whose body was discovered. Investigators are examining evidence including her mobile phone and a motorcycle located near the remains.

stories.title: Disminuye 15.5 % incidencia delictiva en Edomex y suma dos años consecutivos a la baja: INEGI

en.title: Crime incidence decreases 15.5% in State of Mexico, marking second consecutive year of decline: INEGI
en.summary: Crime rates in the State of Mexico have fallen by 15.5 percent, continuing a downward trend for the second consecutive year according to official statistics.

stories.title: Con nueva inversión, Aguascalientes formará parte del corredor digital entre México y Estados Unidos

en.title: With new investment, Aguascalientes becomes part of digital corridor between Mexico and United States
en.summary: A 300 million peso investment will bring over 100 kilometers of underground fiber optic cable and a data center to Aguascalientes, positioning it as a strategic connectivity hub in the North-Bajío corridor.

stories.title: Hallan sin vida a Karla Margarita Pérez, estudiante de medicina en Zapopan, Jalisco; había sido reportada como desaparecida

en.title: Body of Karla Margarita Pérez, medical student in Zapopan, Jalisco, found; she had been reported missing
en.summary: The body of a missing medical student was discovered in Zapopan. A specialized prosecutor's office official noted that contradictory information has emerged during the investigation so far.

stories.title: Sheinbaum y Trump hablaron por teléfono el miércoles, revela Politico; hablaron de relación comercial y nuevos temas, reporta

en.title: Sheinbaum and Trump spoke by phone on Wednesday, Politico reveals; they discussed trade relations and new topics
en.summary: Mexico's president Claudia Sheinbaum and U.S. president Donald Trump held a telephone conversation on Wednesday covering trade relations and other matters.

stories.title: Disminuye 15.5 % incidencia delictiva en EdoMéx y suma dos años consecutivos a la baja: INEGI

en.title: Crime incidence decreases 15.5% in State of Mexico and marks two consecutive years of decline: INEGI
en.summary: The State of Mexico saw crime rates fall from 48,426 crimes per 100,000 residents in 2024 to 40,915 in 2025, extending a downward trend.

stories.title: Politico reporta que Sheinbaum y Trump conversaron el miércoles

en.title: Politico reports that Sheinbaum and Trump conversed on Wednesday
en.summary: U.S. president Donald Trump and Mexican president Claudia Sheinbaum had a telephone conversation on Wednesday, according to Politico.

stories.title: Volvo XC60 PHEV 2026: ya está en México con 81 km de autonomía eléctrica, 462 hp y estos precios

en.title: Volvo XC60 PHEV 2026: now available in Mexico with 81 km of electric range, 462 hp and these prices
en.summary: Volvo's updated mid-size SUV arrives in Mexico with a redesigned front end, slimmer headlights, and an 11.2-inch screen featuring Google Gemini, priced between 1.3 and 1.6 million pesos.

stories.title: Inflar de más las llantas para ahorrar gasolina parece buena idea, pero puede salirte muy caro

en.title: Over-inflating tires to save gasoline seems like a good idea, but it can become very expensive
en.summary: Many drivers attempt to reduce fuel consumption by over-inflating vehicle tires, though exceeding recommended pressure levels carries significant risks and drawbacks.

stories.title: Canadá desafía a Trump y se acerca a la UE; el presidente de EU amenaza con fuertes aranceles a Europa

en.title: Canada challenges Trump and moves closer to the EU; US president threatens strong tariffs on Europe
en.summary: Canada and Europe are expanding their commercial relationship and exploring deeper cooperation in defense, energy, and technology, while facing tariff threats from the US.

stories.title: La IA está fuera de control, ¿y si el problema no es la IA?

en.title: AI is out of control, but what if the problem is not AI?
en.summary: The core challenge with artificial intelligence involves establishing human-defined objectives, limits, and acceptable consequences rather than merely controlling its technical capabilities.

stories.title: Elecciones en Alemania. La frágil y peligrosa desmemoria colectiva

en.title: Elections in Germany: The fragile and dangerous collective amnesia
en.summary: The AfD's electoral success in Saxony-Anhalt highlights the rising influence of far-right movements in Europe and concerns that historical memory of authoritarianism's consequences may fade over time.

stories.title: El impacto del capital natural en la estrategia empresarial

en.title: The impact of natural capital on business strategy
en.summary: Water scarcity, ecosystem degradation, and biodiversity loss pose risks to companies through increased costs, supply chain disruptions, and financing constraints.
